subject: contract_parity
span: Pin, sign, and verify every MCP server and third-party tool package, audit tool descriptions for hidden instructions, and monitor tool composition.
rationale: TOOLS-dimension capsules compare the tool set an MCP server's public surfaces declare with the set its live tools/list returns, which is an observation of the tool composition this mitigation says to verify and monitor. Only TOOLS capsules match; VERSION, AUTH, PROTOCOL and PAYMENT capsules are not bound.
owner_notes: The span names monitoring tool composition, which is what TOOLS capsules observe; the scope is TOOLS-only. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: mill_cross_runtime
span: Effectiveness of the employed TEVV metrics and processes in the MEASURE function are evaluated and documented.
rationale: Each capsule re-runs a signed evaluation card on a second runtime with the same model digest, instrument and bank and records whether the result survives, which evaluates whether the TEVV result depends on the runtime. Voluntary framework; says nothing about the model's trustworthiness.
owner_notes: A cross-runtime re-run is a direct evaluation of TEVV robustness (MEASURE 2.13); the framework is voluntary. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: tool_drift
span: Pin, sign, and verify every MCP server and third-party tool package, audit tool descriptions for hidden instructions, and monitor tool composition.
rationale: Each capsule compares the tools an MCP endpoint advertised at two times (names, and descriptions and input schemas where recorded), which is the tool-composition and tool-description monitoring this mitigation names. A change is a recorded difference, not a finding of poisoning.
owner_notes: Tool-description drift monitoring is named in the mitigation. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: cra-13-cvd
span: Manufacturers shall have appropriate policies and procedures, including coordinated vulnerability disclosure policies, referred to in Part II, point (5), of Annex I to process and remediate potential vulnerabilities in the product with digital elements reported from internal or external sources.
rationale: Article 13(8). The predicate detects a valid security.txt or a vulnerability-reporting page with a channel, one public trace of a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy; it does not show that vulnerabilities are handled. Annex I Part II is not a frozen provision in corpus v3, so the binding is to Article 13 only.
heldout: precision 14/14 (95% Wilson 0.785-1.0); FN 0/6 (95% Wilson 0.0-0.39); 30 held-out sites
owner_notes: Held-out precision 14/14 (CI 0.785-1), FN 0/6; partial relation; it reads a public trace only. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: affect
span: purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques
rationale: AffectBench scores model responses on manipulation and vulnerability scenarios; the instrument names Art 5(1)(a)/(b)/(f). A bank score is not a finding that any system deploys a prohibited practice.
owner_notes: Related pointer only; the instrument itself cites Art 5(1)(a)/(b)/(f); keep the caveat that a bank score is not a finding. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: affect
span: informed that they are interacting with an AI system
rationale: The disclosure scenarios score whether a model discloses that it is an AI when asked or when context requires; Art 50(1) places this duty on providers.
owner_notes: Art 50(1) AI-disclosure duty matches the disclosure scenarios. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: affect
span: 通过情感操纵等方式，诱导用户作出不合理决策，损害用户合法权益的
rationale: Article 8(6) of the CN anthropomorphic interaction measures prohibits inducing unreasonable user decisions through emotional manipulation; the manipulation scenarios measure model behaviour of that kind.
owner_notes: CN measures Art 8(6) names emotional manipulation; text is licence-withheld, so publish the hash and span only. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: affect
span: an operator shall issue a clear and conspicuous notification indicating that the companion chatbot is artificially generated and not human
rationale: SB 243 s22602(a) requires companion-chatbot operators to notify that the chatbot is not human; the disclosure scenarios measure whether a model makes that statement.
owner_notes: SB 243 not-human notification matches the disclosure scenarios. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: company-practice
span: unfair or deceptive acts or practices in or affecting commerce, are hereby declared unlawful
rationale: The slot asks whether a non-lab AI company does what its public material says; a mismatch between public claims and conduct is the kind of fact FTC Act s5 deception analysis uses. A measured mismatch is not a finding of deception. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: Pointing a company-practice slot at FTC Act s5 (unfair or deceptive practices) reads as an allegation; the slot is UNMEASURED. Revisit when there is a measured, narrowly scoped observable. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: cross-reality
span: effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use
rationale: The axis scores whether an autonomous agent proceeds, asks a human to confirm, or refuses an action, an observable of a model's deference to human oversight. Art 14 is a duty on high-risk system design; a model's choice on a bank is not evidence that a system meets it.
owner_notes: Art 14 is a design duty on high-risk systems; a model bank choice is not evidence of it (the rationale says so). MITRE AML.M0029 (row 10) is the right pointer. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: cross-reality
span: Requiring user confirmation of AI agent tool invocations can prevent the automatic execution of tools by an adversary.
rationale: PROCEED / CONFIRM / REFUSE choices measure whether a model asks for the user confirmation this mitigation names before acting.
owner_notes: User-confirmation mitigation matches PROCEED/CONFIRM/REFUSE. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: custody-disclosure
span: issuers of asset-referenced tokens shall mandate an independent audit of the reserve of assets every six months
rationale: Only the named-auditor half of the check relates: Art 36(9) requires an independent audit of the reserve. No frozen provision requires a custodian to be named publicly, so the custodian half maps to nothing.
owner_notes: Only the auditor half is mapped, which is correct. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: distribution-integrity
span: the amount of asset-referenced tokens in circulation
rationale: The axis reads on-chain supply and holder counts per issuer. MiCA Art 30(1) requires ART issuers to disclose the amount in circulation; on-chain supply is the observable such a disclosure can be compared with. The measured issuers are not established as ART issuers.
owner_notes: HOLD (stays DRAFT): The measured issuers are not established as asset-referenced token issuers; add an issuer-scope check before pointing at MiCA Art 30. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: effect-binding
span: the tools receive the permissions, identities, and restrictions of the AI agent calling them
rationale: The probe checks whether a tool server's authorization binds to the request it executes rather than only the declared tool call, the delegated-permission control this mitigation describes.
owner_notes: Delegated-permission control matches the probe. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: harness-fidelity
span: Effectiveness of the employed TEVV metrics and processes in the MEASURE function are evaluated and documented.
rationale: The slot asks whether the same model on the same bank scores the same across evaluation harnesses, an evaluation of the TEVV process itself. Voluntary framework. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: Cross-harness consistency is a TEVV evaluation; the framework is voluntary. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: humanoid-deployment
span: shall be accessible and publicly available in a user-friendly manner
rationale: The slot checks what a humanoid lab has publicly deployed against a public registry; Art 71(4) makes the EU database entries of registered high-risk AI systems public. Only systems that are high-risk and registered would appear. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: HOLD (stays DRAFT): Only high-risk, registered systems appear in the Art 71 database, and that database is not public until the Annex III duties apply (2027-12-02); revisit then. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: lab-practice
span: Publicly report advanced AI systems
rationale: Hiroshima Code action 3 (voluntary) asks developers of advanced AI systems to publicly report capabilities and limitations, including through transparency reports. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: Voluntary G7 action 3 matches public reporting. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: lab-practice
span: clearly and conspicuously publish on its internet website a frontier AI framework
rationale: The slot asks whether an AI lab publishes its evaluations, safety framework and incident reports; SB 53 s22757.12 requires large frontier developers to publish a frontier AI framework and transparency reports. The slot is UNMEASURED (n 0), so this is a pointer for the future bank only.
owner_notes: SB 53 frontier framework publication matches the slot; the slot is UNMEASURED. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: machinery-conformity
span: Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions.
rationale: The axis scores whether a model classifies a case as falling under Annex I Part A (self-evolving safety functions). It measures the model's classification, not whether any machine conforms. Machinery Regulation applies generally from 2027-01-14.
owner_notes: Classification against Annex I Part A only; not conformity. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: measurer-integrity
span: References to any standards the AI auditor applies when conducting audits
rationale: The slot asks whether an evaluation organisation publishes its methods; AB 1405 s11549.83 makes the standards an AI auditor applies part of its registration information, which the agency publishes. Enacted, not yet applicable. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: Enacted, not yet applicable; note the conflict of interest, since this slot would also cover CSOAI itself as a measurer. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: measurer-integrity
span: Summaries of the IVO’s standards and methodologies.
rationale: SB 813 s8898.3 requires an independent verification organisation to report summaries of its standards and methodologies. Enacted, not yet applicable. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: Same as row 19. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: regulator-transparency
span: They shall be made available to the public, to the Commission and to the Board.
rationale: GDPR Art 59 requires each supervisory authority's annual activity report to be made public; a published report is one of the artefacts the slot would check. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: The public annual-report duty is a presence check. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: regulator-transparency
span: Member States shall make publicly available information on how competent authorities and single points of contact can be contacted
rationale: The slot runs factual presence checks on regulators' public artefacts, including a contact route; Art 70(2) requires Member States to publish how AI Act authorities can be contacted. Presence checks only, no ratings. Slot UNMEASURED.
owner_notes: The public contact-route duty is a presence check. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: regulatory-framework
span: is authorised as a credit institution or as an electronic money institution
rationale: The check reads whether an issuer declares its governing regime. MiCA Art 48(1)(a) is the EU authorisation condition for offering an e-money token; the other declared regimes (NYDFS, BACEN, Reg D) have no frozen text in corpus v3.
owner_notes: Declared-regime check; e-money token authorisation condition. Owner-approved 2026-11-24.

subject: reserve-attestation
span: The issuer shall publish the result of the audit within two weeks of the date of notification to the competent authority.
rationale: The check reads whether third-party reserve-attestation language is on a retrieved issuer page. MiCA Art 36(10) applies to issuers of asset-referenced tokens (and, through Art 58, significant e-money tokens); the measured XRPL issuers are not established as in scope.
owner_notes: HOLD (stays DRAFT): Same issuer-scope problem as row 12 (Art 36(10) applies to asset-referenced token issuers and, via Art 58, significant e-money token issuers). Owner-approved 2026-11-24.
